mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.4 percentage points within the last month signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals monetary tightening amid disinflation, reducing equity valuations and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening residential demand, reducing consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines in a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1,100 thousand units signals weak residential demand, reducing consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 108 (index 2017=100) signals a manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 108, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
